Name: Holiday Animals
Author: Anthri
Description:
A small mod that will give your animals a more festive look for the holidays!
The latest version is a patch by Nordmole - who updated it to only have the animals decorated from the 24th to the 26th of winter

Alters : All chickens (except gold for now), both cows, ducks, goats, sheep, dinosaurs, pigs, rabbits, and any other barn/coop animals I may have forgotten.
Does not alter : Horses, Dogs, Cats, or any other animals not in the barn or coop. (ostriches, as they weren't out at the time of uploading - I plan to remedy this)

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher
